meta.title: Invoice Amendment: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open and amend a submitted invoice through the Invoice Amendment flow
Verify refusal or absence for a user without the AP Executive role
Repeat the flow as an AP Executive and verify it is available
Verify both users operate in the same Growth-plan tenant
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and amend a submitted invoice through the Invoice Amendment flow; Verify refusal or absence for a user without the AP Executive role; Repeat the flow as an AP Executive and verify it is available; Verify both users operate in the same Growth-plan tenant

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Executive role in the specified Growth tenant, attempt Invoice Amendment on a submitted invoice, then repeat the same controlled flow as an AP Executive and report whether the action is refused or unavailable for the first user and available for the second

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as role-specific users or operate the Invoice Amendment workflow; the tester must perform both role comparisons.
Confirm the session remains free of an application error after the tester completes the unavailable workflow.
